scope: Second text/design pass after content revision; same assistant, not an independent human review.

englishNaturalness.evidence: Refreshments after a walking-group outing provide a plausible choice; a second round is explicitly marked. The English has been reviewed as short beginner utterances, not as a claim of authentic unscripted dialogue.

persianMeaningQuality.evidence: Checked every turn translation and all option explanations against the intended English meaning, speaker, object and communicative act.

pedagogicalClarity.evidence: A single new conjunction supports a short selection rather than adding unnecessary grammar.

distractorQuality.evidence: The or/and contrast is taught; A06 changes the chosen drink and removes visible answer options.

dialoguePlausibility.evidence: Refreshments after a walking-group outing provide a plausible choice; a second round is explicitly marked.

difficultyFit.evidence: A single new conjunction supports a short selection rather than adding unnecessary grammar.

repetitionUsefulness.evidence: Audio reconstruction is labelled supported practice; the final task removes the model. The or/and contrast is taught; A06 changes the chosen drink and removes visible answer options.

transferQuality.evidence: The or/and contrast is taught; A06 changes the chosen drink and removes visible answer options. Evidence is same-session bounded recall, not a proficiency certificate.

overallCoherence.evidence: Refreshments after a walking-group outing provide a plausible choice; a second round is explicitly marked. Teaching, selection feedback and the terminal task retain the Lesson outcome and played role.

learnerExperience.evidence: Static flow review: optional help, typed fallback and per-option explanations reduce dead ends. No real microphone, perception or learner test was performed.

limitations: Real learner outcomes and delayed retention have not been measured.
Generated audio has not received a perceptual/prosody review.
Exact-match retrieval recognizes bounded patterns; valid alternative English can fall outside its answer list.
